name: Shoco reflection deliver() + pair skim
summary: Shoco's RFI-style deliver() let a holder burn their own reflected balance and inflate tokenFromReflection() for everyone else, so after buying nearly the whole excluded-adjusted supply the attacker could skim the inflated balance back out of the SHOCO/WETH pair.
